parts.text: Sandy embarked on a journey from Holloway Shores to Sun Valley Shores, walking for 8 hours on the first day.
On the second day, she walked half as many hours as she did on the first day to reach Hollock Valley Shores.
However, on the third day, she decided to walk for twice as many hours as she did on the second day to reach her final destination, Moonlight Shores.
Calculate the total time Sandy took to walk in the three days in minutes, considering that each hour contains 60 minutes.

parts.text: While playing with her friends in their school playground, Katelyn saw 50 fairies flying above the nearby forest.
After about twenty minutes, one of her friends saw half as many fairies as Katelyn saw come from the east and join the fairies that were there.
If there were 45 fairies in total after some fairies flew away, how many fairies flew away?
